title: Statutory homelessness: detailed local authority-level tables, January to March 2026 (sheet TA1)
publisher: MHCLG (Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government)
geography: Local authority (England, incl. 33 London boroughs E09)
definition_notes: TA1 col 'Households in TA Total' [note 34]: households in accommodation arranged by LAs pending enquiries or after acceptance as homeless under the 1996 Act (as amended by HRA 2017). Households in area (thousands) per note 5 (2022-based household projections). Suppression markers: [z] n/a, [x] missing, [c] suppressed.
notes: Direct file URL: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a82ee2c92ec93e1e0329a7f/Statutory_Homelessness_Detailed_Local_Authority_Data_202603.ods. Sum of 33 boroughs (76017) differs by 3 from the London row (76020).

title: Live Table 600: households on local authority housing registers (waiting lists), by district
reference_period: 31 March each year 1987-2025 (2018 and earlier use 1 April until 2017-18 per note 3)
definition_notes: Households on LA housing registers, from LAHS Section C. Note 1: a register is not the same as households waiting; review frequency varies and households may be on several registers. Sheet used: Local_Authority_Data.
notes: Direct file URL: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a2be263e50716856ed4afc4/Live_Table_600.ods. Last updated by MHCLG 25 June 2026.

title: Live Table 602: local authority owned dwellings let
definition_notes: LA-owned dwellings let. Only an England-level sheet was found, no Newham or borough rows.
notes: Direct file URL: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6a2be281c39255c595b507bc/Live_Table_602.ods. Downloaded and checked; not used for borough figures.

title: Social housing lettings in England, tenancies summary tables, April 2024 to March 2025 (Tables 1d and 1e used)
definition_notes: Table 1d: new social housing lettings (SR, AR, IR; general needs and supported; LA and PRP) by LA of property. Table 1e: social re-lets, average social vs market rent, stock at 1 April, churn. Counts come from CORE lettings returns.
notes: Direct file URL: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/69147610eba5bda2026fc827/Social_Housing_Lettings_in_England__Tenancies_Summary_Tables__2024-25.ods. Tenants summary tables and the sub-national dashboard not opened.
